DeterminationBasis: T16-001 requires a material claim to remain bounded to its evaluated scope, while T16-011 requires the claim to identify or unambiguously bind the subject to which the claimed property applies. Together these controls require a conformance claim to preserve both the declared evaluation boundary and the specific system, component, workflow, artifact or otherwise bounded subject being evaluated. No additional test definition is required.

T16-009 requires every applicable mandatory requirement to receive one permitted conformance status, preserving the evaluated outcome for each applicable mandatory requirement. T16-007 separately requires completeness of the claimed-profile normative requirement set in the requirements matrix so applicable requirements cannot disappear by omission. Together these controls cover evaluation of all mandatory requirements applicable to the declared profile and scope without requiring a new test definition.
